component.name: Ondrane
component.summary: A native desktop player for videos, music and streams

description.p: Ondrane is an independent Rust and Slint media player powered by libVLC. It includes a media library, resume history, subtitles, six colour-scheme families and native Wayland portals. The Flatpak includes its playback engine and uses desktop portals to select files and share the screen.

screenshot.caption: Video playback with Ondrane’s native interface
